title: Beyond Recall Saturation: Scaling Hard-Negative Reranker Training for Industrial Legal Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.24478v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Industrial retrieval systems often improve quality by enlarging embedding candidate pools or adopting complex training pipelines. We show that, under a sufficiently large but practical candidate pool, embedding recall exhibits diminishing returns, motivating a closer examination of reranker quality. On Chinese legal retrieval benchmarks, embedding top-300 reaches a high-recall operating region, while relevant evidence may still be ranked below the output cutoff. We compare hard-negative strategies for reranker training, including embedding-mined, self-mined, and dynamic-negative variants, under aligned retrieval protocols that evaluate reranking after candidate retrieval. Among the evaluated staged configurations, an embedding-to-self-mined pipeline provides a favorable trade-off; additional dynamic stages do not improve all held-out metrics. The selected pipeline scales from a 0.6B to a 4B reranker. Relative to the native 4B reranke

translated_title: 超越召回饱和：面向工业法律检索的难负样本重排序器训练规模化
translated_abstract: 工业检索系统通常通过扩大嵌入候选池或采用复杂的训练流程来提升检索质量。我们证明，在足够大但切实可行的候选池规模下，嵌入召回呈现边际收益递减，这促使我们更深入地审视重排序器的质量。在中文法律检索基准上，嵌入模型的top-300召回已进入高召回运行区间，但相关证据仍可能排在输出截断线之下。我们在对齐的检索协议下（即在候选检索完成后评估重排序效果）比较了用于重排序器训练的多种难负样本策略，包括嵌入挖掘、自挖掘和动态负样本等变体。在所评估的分阶段配置中，“嵌入挖掘到自挖掘”的流水线提供了有利的权衡；额外的动态阶段并不能改善所有留出集指标。所选流水线可将重排序器从0.6B规模扩展到4B规模。相对于原生4B重排序器……
tldr: 在中文法律检索中，当嵌入召回趋于饱和后，采用“嵌入挖掘到自挖掘”的难负样本分阶段训练流水线是重排序器训练的最佳权衡方案，且可将模型从0.6B扩展至4B。
en_tdlr: Once embedding recall saturates in Chinese legal retrieval, an embedding-to-self-mined staged hard-negative training pipeline offers the best trade-off for reranker training and scales from 0.6B to 4B models.
